The [[Keeper of Spirits]] is one of the [[Forgotten]] collectors who award [[Forgotten weapon]]s in exchange for a [[Book of Secrets]], the [[Nightfall]] end-game reward item. 

==Locations==
*[[Realm of Torment]]
**{{NPC location|Throne of Secrets}}

==Dialogue==
:''"Greetings, hero. There are whispers that you have already walked among the spirits and survived. If this is true, than you have done more than even the greatest champions of the ancient days. It is an honor to meet your acquaintance. If you can find me 1 Book of Secrets, I will call upon the spirits to light your path and grant you a gift in return."''
